name: Paradisus Playa del Carmen, La Esmeralda

address.street: Calle Quinta Avenida Esq. Calle 88 Norte

insider_take: This adults-only sanctuary sits on pristine white sand where ancient Mayan trade routes once crossed the Caribbean coast.
whats_special: Paradisus Playa del Carmen occupies a stretch of beach that was historically significant to the Maya as a departure point for pilgrimages to Cozumel. The resort's Royal Service suites feature swim-up pools and direct beach access, while the property's cenote-inspired spa treatments use traditional Mayan healing techniques passed down through generations.
pro_tip: Book a beachfront Royal Service suite on the north side for the most spectacular sunrise views and closer proximity to Playa del Carmen's famous Fifth Avenue, just a 10-minute walk away.
dont_miss: The underground cenote excursions accessible directly from the resort, where you can snorkel in crystal-clear freshwater caves that the ancient Maya considered sacred portals to the underworld. The nearby Xcaret eco-park and the world's second-largest coral reef system are also within easy reach.
pros: Premium beachfront location with pristine white sand beach access
All-inclusive luxury resort with multiple dining venues and bars
Spacious suites with swim-up pools and premium amenities
World-class spa and wellness facilities with tropical treatments
cons: Large resort property may feel crowded during peak seasons
